name: Shine on Me
description: Her heart was anchored in an unrequited love, while the one who truly saw her from the beginning waited in the wings. A tale of a fateful first encounter that changes everything—and a second chance at a love that was always meant to be.

videos.title: Car Accident
videos.overview: As Nie Xiguang nears graduation, her secret crush, Zhuang Xu, invites her to a group dinner celebrating his new job.

videos.title: Being Wronged
videos.overview: Xiguang prepares for a job interview at a prestigious firm. Former surgeon Lin Yusen proposes a bold strategy at the company's board meeting.

videos.title: Graduation Season
videos.overview: Xiguang quietly refuses Xu's help on her thesis. Meanwhile, her cousin Jiang Rui tries to recruit her to chaperone a college tour in Europe.

videos.title: Entering the Workplace
videos.overview: Xiguang quietly refuses Xu's help on her thesis. Meanwhile, her cousin Jiang Rui tries to recruit her to chaperone a college tour in Europe.

videos.title: Moving to Administration Department
videos.overview: As Xiguang settles into her new role, she has an embarrassing encounter with a handsome executive. Later, she lands in the center of a finance mishap.

videos.title: Passing By
videos.overview: After a tense meeting with Yusen, Xiguang looks for a chance to prove herself - and shake his icy first impression of her.

videos.title: Visiting Lin Yusen's Home
videos.overview: Feeling guilty about wishing Yusen harm, Xiguang volunteers to deliver documents to his home while he recovers from an accident.

videos.title: Misunderstanding Resolved
videos.overview: Yusen rushes to help Xiguang after she suffers a serious fall - revealing a gentler side of his personality she's never seen.

videos.title: Getting Closer
videos.overview: As Xiguang recovers in the hospital, Yusen starts to see her as a friend. Back at work, he suggests a team lunch to lift spirits.

videos.title: Attending Wedding
videos.overview: While attending a wedding as Yusen's plus-one, Xiguang meets his former medical colleagues and learns more about his past career as a surgeon.

videos.title: Love Triangle at the Wedding
videos.overview: Yusen and Xiguang escape the busy wedding festivities to visit an arcade, where they bond over drinks and a lighthearted competition.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: At the wedding reception, Xu confronts Xiguang about her new friendship with Yusen — forcing her to reckon with her feelings for both men.

videos.title: New Mission
videos.overview: After visiting her grandparents, Xiguang decides to keep her distance from Yusen at work while she makes sense of their unorthodox friendship.

videos.title: Business Trip
videos.overview: Xiguang decides to accompany Yusen on a business trip — but before they leave, she sets a ground rule that could shake up their relationship dynamic.

videos.title: Guangzhou In-depth Tour
videos.overview: After their business trip to Guangzhou ends, Yusen and Xiguang explore the city together as she eases her nerves before the flight home.

videos.title: Unexpected Appearance of Ma Nianyuan
videos.overview: Xu organizes a skiing holiday with his family. While setting up for a company annual party, Xiguang defends a coworker from a rude patron's insults.

videos.title: Unexpected Reunion at Changbai Mountain
videos.overview: Xiguang unexpectedly runs into Xu at a shop during a family trip to Changbai Mountain. Meanwhile, Yusen visits his mother in Beijing.

videos.title: Ski Coach
videos.overview: Yusen surprises Xiguang at her family's chalet and pretends to be a ski instructor, allowing him to spend more time with her.

videos.title: Skiing Battle
videos.overview: Xiguang sneaks out to surprise Yusen with an intimate excursion, while Jiang Rui grows jealous and challenges him to a snowboarding race.

videos.title: Emergency Rescue
videos.overview: After Xu's colleague Kevin suffers a serious injury in a collision on the slopes, Yusen draws on his medical expertise to assist the first responders.

videos.title: Let Go of the Past
videos.overview: As an apology for their miscommunication, Yusen invites Xiguang to a personal fireworks display. Meanwhile, Xu extends his trip to look after Kevin.

videos.title: Inheritance Rights
videos.overview: Suspicious of Yusen's professional motives, Xiguang's powerful father Nie Chengyuan launches a private investigation into his affairs.

videos.title: Seize the Opportunity
videos.overview: Chengyuan discovers a shocking truth about Yusen's car accident and confronts his former lover Qian Fangping and her daughter for answers.

videos.title: Confirming the Relationship
videos.overview: After finalizing the design for her photovoltaic garden project, Xiguang opens a heartfelt letter from Yusen, which sheds light on their first meeting.

videos.title: Making the Relationship Public
videos.overview: Xu probes Kevin's memories from before his accident. Xiguang tells her mother about her new relationship, inspiring Yusen to share the news as well.

videos.title: Long-distance Relationship
videos.overview: Before departing on an important work trip, Yusen invites a few close colleagues out to dinner - publicly revealing that his bachelor days are over.

videos.title: Rekindling His Dream
videos.overview: Yusen opens up to Xiguang about his past and admits that he hopes to leave Shuangyuan Photovoltaic and return to the medical field despite his injury.

videos.title: Veto
videos.overview: At the kick-off of a new Shuangyuan project, Xiguang displays her newfound confidence while showing her mother Jiang Yun around the company.

videos.title: Knowing the Truth
videos.overview: Jiang Yun seeks to buy a major share of Shuangyuan, helping to secure Xiguang's future. Later, she expresses her feelings after the divorce.

videos.title: Win Back Her Heart
videos.overview: After learning the truth from Chris, Xu rushes to a friend's birthday party, determined to finally confess his true feelings for Xiguang.

videos.title: Stay Firm by Your Side
videos.overview: While pitching a new major project, Yusen and Xiguang visit a sought-after building site - only to cross paths with a rival company's arrogant leader.

videos.title: Meeting Her Grandparents
videos.overview: When Xiguang hears her grandfather is having dizzy spells, Yusen eagerly volunteers to go with her to the village and diagnose the issue.

videos.title: Illness of Xiguang’s Dad
videos.overview: After Chengyuan collapses, paramedics rush him to the hospital, and Xiguang learns he requires a complicated surgery to treat the issue.

videos.title: Successful Bid
videos.overview: As he prepares for surgery, Chengyuan tries to mend his relationship with Xiguang. Ms. Shen turns to Shuangyuan for support on a key project bid.

videos.title: Reaching a New Level
videos.overview: As Fangping's empire crumbles around her, Xiguang and her family gather to celebrate Shuangyuan's success — and toast to the company's new direction.

videos.title: Shining Light
videos.overview: Years later, as they flourish in their respective careers, Xiguang and Yusen look to the future and plan the next chapter of their shared life.
